next_step.title: Carry out Sheet 56, then the privacy page's UI pass
next_step.text: Sheet 56 asks whether to mock up the Fact Sheet on First Light's type with a dark mode. The next view the UI pass names is the privacy page.

calls.title: Read two records from the tab
calls.text: Irvine Valley's Art A.A. and Santa Monica's Barbering A.S. wait on your reading. Sign in on the Records view, open each record, and choose Confirm or Needs a fix.
calls.if_no_reply: Both records stay unchecked, and Sierra does not quote them.

calls.title: Answer Open Asks Sheet 56
calls.text: One card: mock up the Fact Sheet on First Light's type, light and dark, with the Word and PDF downloads unchanged?
calls.if_no_reply: The Fact Sheet keeps its document type and stays light.

calls.title: Paste the Library record for Sheet 56
calls.text: One receipt moves the open-asks record from Sheet 55 to Sheet 56; the connector times out on this table, so it goes in by paste.
calls.if_no_reply: The Library's open-asks record keeps pointing at Sheet 55.

notes.addenda: The reading agent starts after the Oct 11 census apply.
